title: Tenant priming and staggered circuit thaw to prevent oscillation during regional failovers
author: Aisha Koenig
description: Motivation: regional failovers combined with aggressive reopen behavior were causing tenant-level oscillation and repeated cold KV-cache misses leading to SLO flaps. This PR implements a low-risk hotfix that (1) primes tenant KV prefixes during region handoff windows, (2) staggers circuit-thaw operations across nodes to avoid synchronized reopen spikes, and (3) adds a feature flag and telemetry gates for progressive rollout. Technical summary: added a PrimingManager in the SLO enforcer runtime that schedules lightweight KV prefetch jobs for tenants that are in the failover window; modified the circuit thaw scheduler to use randomized stagger + per-tenant backoff so nodes do not simultaneously move circuits from CLOSED->HALF_OPEN; introduced a feature flag runtime.config.slo.tenant_priming (default: off) and a conservative default thaw_delay_seconds=9 with canary override. Risk mitigation and rollback: the changes are behind a feature flag and guarded by quota controls (concurrent_primers_limit). If telemetry shows increased error rates, the flag can be turned off instantly and thaw_delay can be set to a very large value to keep circuits closed. Canary and results: rolled out to us-east-1 Canary cohort (5% traffic) for 36 hours; observed 42% reduction in cold-KV miss latency spikes and no increase in 5xx rates; one transient flake in e2e-regional-failover tests prompted a delay tuning from 6s->9s. Testing: unit tests for PrimingManager and scheduler jitter, integration test that simulates regional handoff and verifies priming jobs run and succeed, canary harness tests for telemetry emission. Followups: expand priming to include prefix frequency heuristics (ENG-4287), expose tenant-level priming metrics in Console, and evaluate datacenter-local priming when Private deployments are used.

release_notes: Hotfix: reduces post-failover oscillation by priming tenant KV prefixes and staggering circuit thaw operations. Rollout is gated by feature flag runtime.config.slo.tenant_priming; default OFF. Backwards-compatible and reversible.
notes_for_oncall: If increased 5xx or CPU usage is observed after enabling the flag, toggle runtime.config.slo.tenant_priming to false and increase runtime.config.slo.thaw_delay_seconds to a large value; check priming_retry and primer_failure metrics to investigate underprovisioning.
